title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts Desk Note: Batch Type and the Missing-Items Batch-Size Credit
content:
In a missing-items dispute on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the batch-size credit is adjusted by the type of the disputed violation's batch, as its record in Cartwise Shopper Batches names it.

**Rule.** On a Stock-Up Batch the batch-size credit is doubled. On a Double Delivery Batch or a Triple Delivery Batch it is increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point. On any other batch type — Shop-Only Batch, Express 30 Batch or Single Delivery Batch — it is used as it stands.

## Adjusted credit by batch type

| Batch-size credit | Stock-Up Batch | Double or Triple Delivery Batch | Shop-Only, Express 30 or Single Delivery Batch |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | None | None | None |
| 1 point | 2 points | 2 points | 1 point |
| 2 points | 4 points | 3 points | 2 points |

## Working the half (hypothetical credits)

- 1 point on a Double Delivery Batch: half of 1 is 0.5, rounded up to 1; 1 plus 1 gives 2 points.
- 2 points on a Triple Delivery Batch: half of 2 is 1; 2 plus 1 gives 3 points.
- 2 points on a Stock-Up Batch: doubled, 4 points.
- 2 points on an Express 30 Batch: used as it stands, 2 points.

The half is rounded up to a whole point before it is added to the credit.
